title: Digital Chaos
subtitle: A suspicious message arrives while an urgent spreadsheet is wrong and an AI assistant produces an answer that sounds right. You must secure, verify, analyze, and act.

The resourceful move is usually not the cleverest sentence. It is the action that improves the quality of the situation: reduce heat, increase clarity, protect safety, find evidence, identify ownership, and create a next step. Adapt the order to the stakes.
